notes.title: Beta 0.2.4 Persistent NPC Spawn System Update
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

-New Dynamic NPC spawn system:
	-NPC squads will now spawn from origin points in the over world and travel in real time between 
 levels toward objectives or on patrols. 
	-NPC squads and roaming monsters will save their location and status persistently.
	-NPCs will retain their appearance, trade inventors and equipment between level transitions.

-Added Several New Weapons.

-You can now add custom Radio Music:
	Silverfish>Content>Music>Radio  (Currently only .wav files work)

-3 New contracts.



[b]Changes:[/b]

-Added day counter to clock on map screen.

-Added custom insignias for Conscript uniforms. 

-Scav guards at Slums will now have delayed respawns.

-Player can no longer disguise themself as a faction they already have a positive reputation with. 

-Improved red flare particle FX making it less annoying to hold.

-Made Not Deer more susceptible to kinetic dmg.

-Slightly buffed .45 hollow point dmg.

-Slightly buffed 12 gauge slug dmg.

-Made super powerful artifacts more rare. They will now only be found as specific end game rewards. Many of these end game activities are still a work in progress.

-Mamma Roach will no longer reward the player with a Regression Matrix for revealing the bank safe combination. She now gives a more thematic reward. 

-Buffed the Scorcher.

-Dungeon doors will now make an audible noise when NPCs travel through them. 

-Added a lamp to the safe house on black lake.

-Adjusted physics friction of props and surfaces.

-Scoped weapons now scale sensitivity based off of FoV. The Scope slider setting now acts as a general ADS sensitivity multiplier. (You may want to reset your ADS sens slider)

-Familiar Scent now works on all canines. 

-The manor key no longer drops from a butler android. It has a new spawn location.

-Various other changes to the Metropol Manor house.

-Headgear will now properly display faction rep buffs.

-Bandit Jacket with Facemask or Looter Mask can be worn as a Freelancer disguise. 

-Fire Wardstone will now spawn flames on the entity that attacked the player, rather than the player themselves. 

-Revised artifact loot crate pool.

-The descriptions of blue and yellow flares now explain their use.

-The heartbeat sound will now end when the player dies.

-Upon popular request, Freelance and Insurrection stalkers will now accept cash in barters again. 

-Added a kill plane below all levels, if the player hits it, the game will reload the last save, regardless of mode. 




[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Addressed issues with artifact spawning systems.

-Level transitions properly advance time. 

-Fixed weird glass refraction. 

-Fixed muzzle velocity of the H-SMG 45 and its variants.

-Fixed bugs associated with redeeming quest rewards. 

-Fixed weapons dropping out of the bottom of loot chests. 

-Made disguises getting forced compromised work even if you momentarily remove your disguise. 

-Loot items no longer phys glitch with rag dolls.

-Large NPCs will no longer spawn in small spaces that can trap them. 

-Barter interact points will now correctly deactivate when traders are killed. 

-Fixed various broken nav mesh spots.

-There is no end to the typos I must fix.

-The correct warning message will now appear when you try to abandon a contract. 

-Fixed broken text on FPS limit setting.

-Player rep bonus will now be correctly applied when NPCs are IDing the player.

-The Handy Man will now only grab NPCs that can see it.

-Addressed an issue that was causing explosion damage to not proc on certain destructible entities like turrets and demolition quest objectives. 

-Faction rep buffs now actually work properly. 

-Fixed Cult Stalkers sometimes having Insurrection logos on their backpacks. 

-Arc Wardstone should no longer damage the player. 

-Increased LoD bounds for Starburst PFX.

-Explosive projectiles will now detonate on water surface.

-Fish will now immediately stop biting after picking up the Pale Bone Artifact.

-Artifacts should no longer be able to spawn under artifact craters. 

-Many other minor changes and tweaks. 


[b]Known Issues:[/b]

-Some Tarot card effects will need to be re-factored in order to work better in the new spawn system.

notes.title: 0.1.9.6 HotFix
notes.content:
Hopefully the last one for a while.

-Fixed issue that was causing certain graphics settings to not properly save when edited.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.9.5
notes.content:
[p]-Addressed performance issues introduced in previous patch.  

-Load times should now be faster.   

-Game files are now packed for better efficiency. 
 This will affect the work flow for mod developers, but it shouldn't be too much of an issue to get past.[/p]

notes.title: Beta 0.1.9.4 Hot Fix
notes.content: Removed radio music that was causing copyright claims on YouTube and Twitch.

notes.title: Beta 0.1.9.1 Patch
notes.content:
[p][b]New Features:[/b]  

-New Random Character, Perma-death, Quick-Play option on character screen.  

-Melee enemies now have new contingency behaviors for when their combat target is out of reach. Based on their class, they will do one of the following: 	
   -Hide from target. 	
   -Throw rocks at target. 	
   -Aggressively lunge at target. 	
   -Run around frantically.   

-New Advanced Options Tab now available in the difficulty mode select screen. These new options will be available to configure along-side any game mode: 	
   -Combine all stashes into a single inventory.  	
   -Replace all Shops with Barter trades. 	
   -Ignore Progress Curve.   


[b] Changes:[/b]

-Made barter shops value cash at 50%.

-NPCs will no longer accept cash in barters, only barter shops will.

-Re-balanced artifact trades in barters.

-Loner Scavs no longer have the active tracking skill.

-Distrusting NPCs will forget about the player if not further provoked after warning. 

-Re-balanced enchanted weapon crafting recipes to be more reasonable and reflect other changes in game. 

-Acid pools now conform their shape to the terrain.

-Improved clarity of UI rendering.

-Added animation when opening the UI.

-Improved the way EMPs affect the player's equipment. Flashlights, night-vision and lasers  will have their effects disabled for several seconds rather than being turned off.

-Bright blue and yellow glass chemical bottles will now spawn small acid pools when broken. 

-Slightly randomized the move speeds of horde type enemies to make them more dynamic in fights. 



[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Fixed issue where NPCs reloading Eather weapons would reduce player's Eather supply. 

-Fixed yet more typos.

-Players should no longer be warned about wearing a disguise in safe zones where they are allied with their disguised faction, or if the safe zone is neutral/empty. 

-Fixed issues where anomalies in the Slums could often spawn under the street. 

-Fixed spot where player could get stuck in subway dungeon. 

-Fixed some issues with melee enemy pathing.

-Fixed bug that caused special loot crates to be locked into only giving certain kinds of loot regardless of seed.

-Fixed issue where fire jet anomaly could sometimes deal no damage. 

-Decals attached to rag-dolls and other physics objects will no longer get smeared across nearby level geometry.
[/p]

notes.title: Beta 0.1.8.3 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

-You can now offer cash in the barter screen.

-More NPC types have available trades. 

-New over-world map.

-New trader NPC.

-A couple new weapon variations. 



[b]Changes:[/b]

-Insurrectionists will be less dominant on Crossroads.

-Reinforcement spawns that lead to faction bases only spawn squads of that faction.

-Improved loot and interior scenery in the Slums.

-Added Artifact Spawns to the Docks.

-Added Artifact Spawns to the Slums.

-Adjusted NPCs' Line of Sight range so that they are less helpless in the dark.

-Made fall damage more forgiving. 

-Non magnifying sights will no longer be affected by scope sensitivity scale.

-Strafe camera roll will now scale with view-bobbing for the time being. 

-Removed certain items from red chest loot pool. Some moved to blue pool.

-Made random reputation option in custom start feel more random.

-Re-balanced NPC trade pools.

-Made arc grenades worth more.

-Reduced Eather Affinity perk cost from 5 to 4.

-Buffed Lucky Looter perk.

-Reduced amount of extra damage taken with Thin Skin.

-Completely re-balanced NFTA Ranger weapon pool. They will no longer spawn with red chest tier loot. 

-Destroying the core in the refinery will compromise your disguise. 

-NPCs will no longer throw grenades at melee enemies or NPCs that are sprinting. 

-Reworked DoT code for fire and toxic water, making them do more consistent damage. 

-Starburst anomaly blasts no longer ignore cover. 

-The crafting recipe for the Vortex rifle now uses a more common variant of the .338 CSR rifle.

-Increased fall-off distance of NPC vocal attenuation.

-Improved Molotov fire effect. 

-Slightly increased .45 RPC ammo drop rates.

-Reduced damage resistances of Wraith.

-Many other minor changes.




[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Made it less likely for large groups of NPCs to get stuck in the Depot office stairwell. 

-Addressed issue where physics prop collisions could cause the player to fall to their death. 

-NPCs will now lower their weapons when pressed up against obstacles and can no longer fire through thin walls. 

-Fixed bug that showed a glimpse of the handyman screen effect on level load. 

-Fixed inconsistent IFF target reading with binoculars. 

-Fixed item duplication bug.

-NPC Weapons now have recoil.

-NPCs will no longer try to pick up items dropped by the player. 

-Fixed reticle size for reflex sight.

-Fixed yet more typos.

-Fixed issue with scope sensitivity setting.

-Addressed issue where turrets would not take rocket damage. 

-Fixed bug where throwing grenades, mines or IEDs would not update your carry weight. 

-NPCs will no longer offer broken money stacks as trades.

-Fixed glitch where NPCs could not fire through the chain-link mesh of the cable car. 

-Electrode anomalies can no longer damage you through walls. 

-Player intoxication will now reset on death.

-Fixed a couple of incorrect hit-boxes. 

-Fixed a few areas in early game where players can trap themselves.

-Fixed funky light effects inside the observatory. 

-Arc Warden will no longer attack dead bodies. 

-Increased Cultist idle dialogue volume.

-NPCs can now properly aim at target body parts, allowing them to more accurately shoot crawling and non-humanoid enemies.

-Addressed issue where you could still accept contracts from dead quest givers. 

-Fixed issue where you could still trade with dead traders. 

-Addressed many issues with NPC friendly fire. 



[b]Known Issues:[/b]

-Some of the radio music is getting content matched on YouTube and Twitch, despite some of these songs being over 100 years old. 
In the meantime, radio music has been moved to the music volume channel so that it can be muted on streams.
This is a temporary solution.

notes.title: Beta 0.1.6 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Features:[/b]

-New weapons.

-Individual NPCs can now use the new barter system.

-Barter system now has little arrows on item cards that denote the trader's preference. 

-NPCs will now actively seek shelter during severe weather. 

-You can now spend cash to pay off portions of your debt with the Broker.


[b]
Changes:[/b]

-Gave NFTA snipers bolt-action sniper with red laser in place of CSR.

-Put CSR in rare loot pool, 

-Re-balanced prices of .338 sniper rifles.

-Re-balanced loner stalker weapon pool.

-Wrenches are less common in the loot pool.

-NPCs will have limited combat LOS range in low visibility conditions and will no longer fire at targets that should be impossible to see. (Unless they have night vision)

-Reduced fog density during lightning storms. 

-Changed "Fan the Flames" quest to keep track of destroyed fuel tanks between level loads. 

-Made NPCs less likely to run through glass web anomalies. 

-Updated Insurrection Irregular models, making them more distinct as paramilitary forces. 

-Added Hunger meter to Cooking screen.

-Made barter shop trades at Borough more generous and offer more food.

-NPCs now have to take account of visibility conditions when re-acquiring a target. 

-NFTA snipers no longer have the Active Tracking skill. 

-Random NPCs will now no longer spawn with Spratt's shotgun.

-Replace Blue chest in Perdition with Red chest.

-Changed Revolution's radio reinforcements from normal fire team to Haz-Op team so that they are more consistently effective and won't immediately die to map hazards.

-Added more cover at entrance or Refinery.

-You can now trade with Insurrection guards at the sawmill and dead end base if you have good rep with this faction. 

-Changed starting location on Skeleton Coast to be less obnoxious on new runs.

-Made more of Mamma Roach's missions give more valuable items as rewards.

-Put a keypad lock on the door to TUNNEL 225 so that new players are less likely to wander in there while exploring other leads.

-Gave HandyMan a new charge up effect to their grab attack.




[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Fixed camera offset in item inspection screen.

-Addressed possible cause of infinitely respawning artifact.

-Hid tiny cube found on binoculars and Familiar Totem. 

-Fixed glitch where Regression matrix couldn't teleport player off of a ladder. 

-Fixed bug where NPCs could steal medical items from med bag.

-Fixed bug where NPCs could steal items from inspect screens. 

-Fixed misc issues with inventory system. 

-Fixed Healthy Appetite not giving instant health at camp fires.

-Fixed issue where NPCs could not see player through chain link gate.

-NPCs will now be deterred from standing in radiation sources until they die.

-Other misc bugs.

-Fixed issue where you could not call for reinforcements with the radio in Refinery. 

-Fixed Pride Flag patch texture.

-Addressed a potential issue with props being set on fire causing poor performance.

-Temporarily removed Melee enemy zig-zag behavior as it was the root cause of a major performance issue. 

-Fixed issues with insurrection trader and bounty board at Saw Mill.

-Fixed visual bug when changing patch in inventory. 

-You can no longer trade with enemy stalkers by sneaking up on them. 

-Fixed wonky ladder on ship-wreck in Skeleton Coast. 

-Selecting a Faction Base start on a random rep character will now spawn you at the Lone Wolf bar rather than a random over-world map. 

-Fixed a few areas where NPCs can get stuck on scenery. 

-Safe zones with no NPCs will no longer give you warnings about wearing a disguise. 




[b]Known Issues:[/b]

-Shadow entities are not visible on low shadow quality settings. 

-We are looking into adding a feature to allow you to offer cash as part of a barter deal.

notes.title: Beta 0.1.4 HotFix
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b]

-Addressed performance issue with inventory screen. It should now have less of a severe performance impact on certain hardware. 

-Fixed some typos.

-Fixed dark lighting in item inspect screen. 

-Fixed issue with auto-sort not working correctly. 

[b]New Bug:[/b]

-Minor issue where item inspect will be zoomed out and at odd angle. This will be fixed soon.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3: Bug fixes and QoL changes.
notes.content:
[b]Beta 0.1.3 Patch[/b]

[b]New Features:[/b]

-Marking a target with Binoculars will now give a faction IFF.



[b]Changes:[/b]

-Increased custom perk limit from 4 to 5.

-Made certain doors unable to be opened by NPCs.

-Removed 'Crafting' perk from custom perk options. This perk is easy to obtain with a common item and not worth a slot.

-Buffed bolt throw distance.

-Improved warnings for entering faction bases while disguised or distrusted. 

-Gave basic pump shotgun iron sights. 

-Increased NFTA reinforcements at end of the Refinery Raid.

-Improved a reward at end of Dead Bridge Raid. 

-Increased ammo capacity of under-barrel shotgun from 3 shells to 4.

-The K key will no longer show FPS on screen. This function has been moved to the cheat menu. 

-Burner traps anomalies will now do a Line-of-Sight trace before triggering. 

-Changed pump room door in Perdition to be blocked by wood boards rather than locked by a switch. 

-Changed Crash site difficulty to better scale with reward and pacing. 

-Added more loot to Refinery.

-Added more consequences for destroying Refinery Core. 

-Changed Binoculars min and mid zoom levels.

-NPCs who lack night vision should be less capable of tracking targets in poor visibility conditions. 

-The game will now save your weapon's lowered state. 

-Hand-held flashlights will now always point where the player is looking, even while sprinting, swimming or climbing ladders. 

-Enemy respawn times have been slowed down in Cistern and RG East.

-Made logo intro video quieter. 




[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

-Fixed a major bug where NPCs would aim at their target directly, even when their location was not known. They will now aim at and investigate the last known location as they are meant to. 

-Sort button on inventories no-longer shows when Auto-sort is enabled. 

-Fixed nav mesh issue in the Swamp Map.

-Fixed bug that let you steal equipment and weapons from barters. 

-Addressed possible cause of an occasional performance issue, investigation still in progress.

-Removed a problematic anomaly from Cistern spawn pool.

-Fixed some typos.

-Fixed helicopter gun sound effect. 

-Made it harder to steal gold through bank vault bars. 

-Fixed the reflex sight on the tac SMG.

-Changed damage model for explosive fuel drums so that they no longer explode by being lightly pushed or shoved.

-Fixed step collision of smoke tower foundations outside Dr, Mosby's lab. 

-Fixed nav mesh issues in UT 308.

-Fixed out of bounds glitch in T-1806.

notes.title: Project Silverfish Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Project Silverfish goes into Early Access at the end of this month![/b]

Here's a break-down of all the major changes and new features Demo players will see!

[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984028/e52937a23667c9f91aba98124132a626ca04dccb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Beta 0.1, Early Access Release:[/b] 
[/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b]
[/p][p]-New character creator![/p][p][/p][p]-New overworld maps![/p][p][/p][p]-Several new dungeons.[/p][p][/p][p]-New contracts.[/p][p][/p][p]-Many new weapons.[/p][p][/p][p]-New artifacts.[/p][p]
-New story questlines (Still WiP).[/p][p][/p][p]-TVs will now play full video. You can add any .mp4 or .mov file to the folder: [i]Silverfish>Content>Movies>TV_Clips[/i] and the TV will play them.[/p][p][/p][p]-New ammo caliber, .338 Magnum has been added for several sniper rifles.[/p][p][/p][p]-There is now more than one way to reach the Northern Zone.[/p][p][/p][p]-New Eather power armor.[/p][p]
-New weather events.[/p][p][/p][p]-New Crafting system.[/p][p]
-New enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]-New lore.[/p][p][/p][p]-New trades and item requests from major NPCs[/p][p]
-New experimental faction starts, [u]VERY MUCH A WIP.[/u][/p][p][/p][p]-Radiation damage now works. The Detector item now also has a geiger counter. [/p][p]
-A search bar has been added to shops and stashes. [/p][p]
-New enchanted ammo. (Might be craftable in the future*)[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984028/2251c801ae2a8f238aca755b4f04dadb817e29c3.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Changes:[/b]
[/p][p]-Backpacks dropped on death no longer despawn upon your next death. Instead, all dropped backpacks will remain persistent until found and will decay one random item each day they are left un-found.[/p][p][/p][p]-Important quest items marked with a star will never decay from a backpack, and will always drop in a backpack on all modes other than Mercy or Permadeath. [/p][p][/p][p]-Virtual Shadow Maps setting has been removed as it no longer functions with re-vamped shadows.[/p][p]
-New, more user friendly save system.[/p][p]
-Disguise system has been made more robust and straightforward.[/p][p]
-9mm ammo has had a damage buff.[/p][p]
-The in-game economy and loot distribution has been completely overhauled.[/p][p]
-Thematically relevant loot will spawn in specific locations and new types of lootable containers. [/p][p]
-NPCs now have more diverse voice acting between factions, (some of this is still WiP and placeholder).[/p][p]
-Military reinforcement system has been -re-balanced. [/p][p]
-Some existing quests have been slightly changed or given better clues.[/p][p]
-AI improvements and re-balancing.[/p][p]
-Changes to how Tesseract Artifacts work.[/p][p]
-More destructible objects.[/p][p]
-UI polish and improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]-Reworked how fail penalties work for contracts: Contracts no longer fail on death, penalties are invoked when a contract is abandoned or breached by the player's deliberate actions. [/p][p]
-Limit for active contracts has been simplified: Player can hold 5 Contracts at once, story quests and major missions are handled separately under their own header. [/p][p][/p][p]-Dr. Mosby's lab now has a public terminal where all data tapes turned in to him as quests can be re-downloaded. [/p][p]
[/p][p]-Dr. Mosby's lab now has a data tape reader. [/p][p][/p][p]-NPCs who are 'Distrusting' of the player now have more nuanced behavior. [/p][p](Except for the military, they shoot enemies on sight) 
 They will react to things like you lowering your weapon, aiming at them, getting too close, ect.[/p][p][/p][p]-You will now lose relevant faction rep for destroying turrets, vehicles and faction infrastructure. [/p][p][/p][p]-You now Hold G to lower your weapon instead of F. (Default keys)[/p][p][/p][p]-Re-balanced health regeneration. [/p][p][/p][p]-Certain themed head-wear will now give rep bonuses/penalties to certain factions.[/p][p][/p][p]-Changed how turrets and guards in raids will respawn.[/p][p][/p][p]-Added flash option to the camera item.[/p][p][/p][p]-Made various improvements to stealth mechanics. [/p][p][/p][p]-Bolt-action and pump-action weapons now cycle when the trigger is released rather than automatically after firing.[/p][p][/p][p]-Some shops will lower their prices as your reputation improves with their faction. [/p][p][/p][p]-Buffed grenade damage. You can now also 'cook' grenades. [/p][p][/p][p]-Pyrogeists are less aggressive. [/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984028/e7e5b7c2e31e54ceaa089b86027c25b38e60432a.png"][/img]

[/p][p][b]Major Bug Fixes:[/b]
[/p][p]-Major performance improvements. [/p][p][/p][p]-Fixed issues with sound occlusion.[/p][p][/p][p]-Artifact respawning has been fixed; they will now refresh correctly each time a particular new in-game event occurs. [/p][p][/p][p]-Fixed major issues with Melee enemy pathing. [/p][p]
-Fixed huge memory leak caused by rain particles. [/p][p]
-Fixed a bunch of weird visual artifacts caused by fog.[/p][p]
-Under-barrel attachments on weapons now work correctly and can use all ammo types of their caliber. [/p][p]
-The demon known as "Nanite" has been fully exorcised from the game.[/p][p][/p][p]-Prop surfing should be fixed.

-As well as dozens of smaller, miscellaneous bugs and tweaks.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984028/0f8108e37aa7cb10ab28005a238743697778bf6c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTICE: 
[u]Save files are not transferable between the Demo and the Early Access build!
[/u][/b](They would just break anyway, sorry.)[/p]

notes.title: Final Demo Update.
notes.content:
[b]Alpha 0.14.9[/b]

This should hopefully be the last patch for the free demo. 
All development will now be focused toward actually finishing the game.

-Backpack now has a large auto-pickup radius and will hopefully be less likely to float in the air. 

-All NPCs have had their panic rate reduced. 

-Fixed weird shadows in Subway dungeon. 

-Improvements made to 3D audio. (Still WiP)

-Made low-tier loot no longer seeded. (Red and blue chests and armor lockers still are)

-NPCs will be less likely to walk into poison gas towers' radius. 

-Made splashing SFX quieter. 

-Buffed grenade launcher damage and blast radius. 

-Dead NPCs will no longer be able to take loot.

-NPCs will no longer be able to steal consumables from the player's hands. 

-Slightly reduced player hunger rate. 

-Trading Stalkers in safe zones will no longer sigh all the time. 

-NPCs will no longer shout warnings to monsters, animals and anomalies. 

-Blue locked door in Cistern will no longer take the Warehouse office key. 

-Nearby items should now show up in anomaly fields. 

-Fixed issue where particular roaming anomaly would spam attacks with no cool-down, often resulting in game crashing. 

-Fixed issue where journals could be carried over between save files. 

-Arc Wardens no longer spawn with Cultist fire teams. 

-Fixed issues with Arc Warden target acquisition. 

-Fixed misc AI pathing issues. 

-NPCs can no longer pick up and take armed land mines. 

-EMP fields now disable the Eather Detector. 

-Adjusted barbed wire hitbox on fence gate in Dead Bridge so its less likely to kill you when opening it. 

-Fixed issues that cause rapid water splashing while swimming. 

-Fixed lockpicks and skeleton key working at infinite range. 

-Fixed yet another funky ladder. 

-Make that 2...

-Fixed issue where player could take treasure from bank vault through the bars. 

-NPCs will no longer steal quest items. 

-Fixed aggressive enemy spawns at entrances of some dungeons. 

-Fixed issue where grenades would not stack into certain weapon slots that had them equipped. 

-Fixed some typos.

-Other misc bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: Alpha Demo v 0.14.7 Update.
notes.content:
Alpha 0.14.7

-NPCs can now scavenge loot from the ground. 

-Added binaural audio settings and occlusion to NPC sounds.

-Made change to death bag spawning system to hopefully make it less likely to fall through the floor. 

-Tweaked spawn rates of common loot. 

-Number of available contracts from each board will now slowly increase over in-game days.

-Made certain contracts exclusive to the job boards of the respective client. 

-Fixed issue where some bushes could be invisible on lower foliage quality settings. 

-Added images of Faction members to Faction Info panel in Journal. 

-Fixed out-dated description of Freelancer faction outfits.

-Made Insurrection camo more brown so as to be less ambiguous.

-Sleeping will consume less food. 

-Made TAA the default Anti-aliasing method. 

-Made improvements to certain enemy models. 

-Increased NPC step height so they get stuck less often. 

-Fixed water physics volume on Metropol being too small. 

-Fixed a few typos. 

-Other various tweaks and changes.
